title: Woman suspected in Monaco bombing found shot dead near Kyiv, prosecutors say
summary: The body of the Ukrainian woman suspected of planting a parcel bomb in Monaco last week was found near Kyiv, the local newspaper Ukrainska Pravda reported Tuesday.
